HediffDef.label: closing move
HediffDef.description: The next newly accepted ordinary native attack warmup gains30percent of its original integer duration, rounded down. Zero warmup stays zero. This charge expires after three seconds and is spent before the timer changes.

HediffDef.label: sword circle contract
HediffDef.description: One wearer has contracted this opponent for six seconds. The wearer takes12percent less native direct injury from other enemies and every third qualifying near hit on this opponent releases the frozen sharp follow-up. Moving either party beyond eight cells ends the contract.

HediffDef.label: answering blade reserve
HediffDef.description: A native hostile melee injury earned a two-second reserve of half its actual injury, at most20. The next actual native direct hit within three cells consumes it to repair real wounds and slow that target for two seconds.

HediffDef.label: broken tempo
HediffDef.description: One spent counter reserve slows ordinary attack speed by20percent for two seconds. Native melee and ranged cooldown factors apply once; authors retain separate finite sources.
